python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

template = Path('/config/template.env').read_text().splitlines()
overrides = {}
for line in Path('/config/overrides.txt').read_text().splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or '=' not in line:
        continue
    key, value = line.split('=', 1)
    overrides[key.strip()] = value

result = []
pattern = re.compile(r'^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:-([^}]*)\}$')
for line in template:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line.strip())
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f'Invalid template line: {line!r}')
    key, default = match.groups()
    result.append(f'{key}={overrides.get(key, default)}')

output = '\n'.join(result) + ('\n' if result else '')
Path('/app').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
Path('/app/.env').write_text(output)
print(output, end='')
PY
